triples.head_surface: steam or oil will not come in contact with the energized parts
triples.head_canonical_zh: 蒸汽或油接触带电部件
triples.tail_surface: provision is to be made so that the steam or oil will not come in contact with the energized parts in case of leakage
triples.evidence_text: Where steam and oil gauges are mounted on the main-control assembly, provision is to be made so that the steam or oil will not come in contact with the energized parts in case of leakage.

triples.tail_surface: All levers for operating contactors, line switches, field switches and similar devices are to be interlocked
triples.evidence_text: All levers for operating contactors, line switches, field switches and similar devices are to be interlocked to prevent their improper operation.

triples.head_surface: opening of any main circuits without first reducing the field excitation to zero
triples.head_canonical_zh: 未减励磁即断开主电路
triples.tail_surface: Interlocks are to be provided with the field lever
triples.evidence_text: Interlocks are to be provided with the field lever to prevent the opening of any main circuits without first reducing the field excitation to zero

triples.tail_surface: All nuts and connections are to be fitted with locking devices
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 螺母和连接件加装锁紧装置
triples.evidence_text: All nuts and connections are to be fitted with locking devices to prevent loosening due to vibration.

triples.tail_surface: Clearance and creepage distances are to be provided between parts of opposite polarity and between live parts and earth
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设置电气间隙和爬电距离
triples.evidence_text: Clearance and creepage distances are to be provided between parts of opposite polarity and between live parts and earth to prevent arcing

triples.tail_surface: provision is to be made for access to the stator and rotor coils
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 提供定子转子线圈检修通道
triples.evidence_text: For purposes of inspection and repair, provision is to be made for access to the stator and rotor coils

triples.tail_surface: withdrawal and replacement of field coils
triples.evidence_text: provision is to be made for access to the stator and rotor coils, and for the withdrawal and replacement of field coils

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 换向器和滑环表面修复
triples.evidence_text: Adequate access is to be provided to permit resurfacing of commutators and slip-rings
Adequate access is to be provided to permit resurfacing of commutators and slip-rings, as well as the renewal and bedding of brushes.
